short.en: Remember only what affects the future

t.zh: 还是三把钥匙。可这一关的状态只记红钥匙，表只有 2 层。
t.en: Three keys again. But this level’s state remembers only the red key, so the table has just 2 layers.

goal.zh: 算出合法路线的条数，看看只记一把钥匙够不够。
goal.en: Work out the number of valid routes, and see whether remembering one key is enough.

how.zh: 每一格把两层都算一遍。
how.en: Every cell works out both layers.

body.zh: 绿钥匙没有门；蓝门之前一定先捡到蓝钥匙。这两件事不影响未来，不用记。只记红钥匙，2 层就够了。
body.en: The green key has no door; the blue door always comes after the blue key. These two things don’t affect the future, so there’s no need to remember them. Remembering only the red key, 2 layers are enough.
